svg.text: N-Tier Production Topology: Core Deployment Components
Requests traverse presentation, firewall, web/app load balancers, proxy, and database servers
1. Presentation Tier: Client Applications / Browsers (Outside Internal Firewall)
2. Firewall & Security Barrier (Monitors Traffic Between Networks)
Permits or blocks packets via security rules; modern stacks add Web Application Firewall (WAF) + TLS
3. Web Tier: Web Load Balancer -> Web Servers (Server Farm)
Distributes concurrent HTTP requests; delivers web pages, files, images, and videos (or offloads to CDN)
4. Application Server Tier: App Load Balancer / Reverse Proxy -> Application Servers
Runs server-side business logic, transaction rules, and database coordination (e.g., Node.js / Express)
5. Data Tier: Database Server + DBMS <-> High-Availability Replica
DBMS stores and controls data access; HA replica provides failover reliability (+ separate point-in-time backups)
Flexible Stack Tip: Many modern apps serve static assets via CDN and route APIs straight from a proxy to app servers
